derived_by: fixtures/photon/derive_expected.py, from the intake envelopes and the readable transcripts

queries.question: Who commented on PHO-48?
queries.source: jira.md, section PHO-48: the '> **Name** date PT:' comment lines
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Message)-[:REFERENCES]->(w:WorkItem {group_id: $jira, external_id: $issue}) WHERE p.group_id = $jira RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS person ORDER BY person

queries.question: Which messages are in the #photon-bugs thread that starts '0.3.0 is bad. Photon shows up ...', and who sent them?
queries.source: slack.md, section #photon-bugs: the parent line and its indented replies
queries.cypher: MATCH (m:Message {group_id: $slack})-[:PART_OF]->(c:Conversation {group_id: $slack, external_id: $thread}) MATCH (i:Identity {group_id: $slack})-[:RESOLVES_TO]->(:Person)-[:AUTHORED]->(m) RETURN i.external_id AS sender, m.embed_text AS text ORDER BY m.created_at, m.external_id

expect.text: 0.3.0 is bad. Photon shows up in the Dock, the launcher has a title bar with traffic lights, appearance is stuck on light, the panel moves when clicked, and app icons do not render. Dock screenshot is going on the issue.

queries.question: Which issues are linked to PHO-19 ('relates to')?
queries.source: jira.md: '- relates to' lines of PHO-19 and of the issues naming it
queries.cypher: MATCH (a:WorkItem {group_id: $jira})-[:RELATES_TO]-(b:WorkItem {group_id: $jira, external_id: $issue}) RETURN DISTINCT a.external_id AS issue ORDER BY issue

queries.question: What are PHO-19's type and status, and how many issues are in each status?
queries.source: jira.md: the 'Task, To Do' line of PHO-19, and the status line of every issue
queries.cypher: MATCH (w:WorkItem {group_id: $jira}) RETURN w.status AS status, count(*) AS issues, collect(CASE WHEN w.external_id = $issue THEN w.item_type END)[0] AS type_of_issue ORDER BY status

queries.question: Does anything cross from the Jira subgraph into the Slack one?
queries.source: the data: Jira and Slack records are loaded into their own subgraphs, so no edge may join them and each node's source must match its subgraph
queries.cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE n.group_id IN [$jira, $slack] WITH n.group_id AS grp, collect(DISTINCT n.source) AS sources, count(*) AS nodes CALL { MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) WHERE a.group_id IN [$jira, $slack] AND a.group_id <> b.group_id RETURN count(r) AS crossing } RETURN grp, sources, nodes, crossing ORDER BY grp
